title: Minecraft Click
blurb: Wood on wood, about as plain as a sound can be, and somehow one of the most recognisable noises in gaming. Every menu button in Minecraft answers with this click, so anyone who played as a child has heard it tens of thousands of times without ever consciously noticing. That is good interface design doing its job invisibly. The same tick doubles as the in-world button press, meaning it covers both the settings menu and a secret redstone door. Perfect for punctuating a joke on a call.
